jobs.name: flatWindows
jobs.prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Edit target image 1 is the eight-window game atlas. Image 2 is the REQUIRED exact flat 2D cartoon character style. Redraw the entire eight-frame window atlas in the flat ink-and-cel style of image 2, especially replacing the overly rendered puppet-like clowns. Preserve 4 equal columns x 2 equal rows and the exact chronological eight actions: closed red wooden circular gold porthole, half-open, open empty, cheerful red clown peeking with hands on sill, clown aiming a little brass fire cannon LEFT, same with lit cannon mouth, same firing flame left eyes squeezed shut, broken empty window. Same size and exact center for every circular rim. Every cell fully isolated on genuine transparent background with generous gutters. Character: oversized round white face, single clean black oval eye with white highlight, round red nose, simple round red curl shapes, tiny red pointed hat, red costume, white glove mittens. Flat opaque white face with NO cheek shadows, no tan skin, no 3D volume. Solid saturated red and yellow fills. At most one very small hard-edged darker-red shadow under hat and collar, never gradient shading. Strong clean uniform black cartoon outline. Rims and cannons use two flat gold tones, not metallic rendering, no bevel gloss, no texture, no specular rim lights. Preserve all readable actions, rim proportions and consistent character scale. No text, no checkerboard, no background scene, no sepia, no painterly gradients.

jobs.name: understory
jobs.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create a practical flat 2D side-scrolling game midground ground-cover atlas, matching the hand painted cartoon forest in the reference. Two very wide horizontal strips stacked in two equal rows, separated by a transparent gutter, entire canvas roughly 3:1. Top strip: a continuous low hedge of sage and deep teal-green woodland bushes, ferns, straw grass, small rounded rocks, a few roots and brown dry leaves, sunset lit gently with restrained ochre. Bottom strip: exactly the same continuous low ground-cover arrangement after fire: charred scrub, ash-brown dry grass, blackened fern shapes, low burnt sticks, warm dusty grey rocks, a few muted glowing embers. Each strip is a complete unbroken undulating silhouette of undergrowth, low throughout, no tall trees, no sky, no characters. Make the bushes chunky readable shapes with ink outlines and limited hand painted shading. Neither 3D nor glossy, not photographic. Both strips must have a flat continuous opaque base across entire width at the same local row height, leaves project upward at varied heights; true alpha above the leafy silhouette and below each strip, horizontal edges reach the sides at a matching low height for tiling. A thin fringe of dry leaves and earth along each base blends naturally onto painted dirt floor, no geometric bottom bar, no deep exposed roots or cross section. Must be small vegetation suitable behind playable characters and between the background and footpath. No lighting halos outside silhouettes, no blur, no text, no divider lines.

jobs.name: hollow
jobs.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Make one transparent raster scenery cutout of a shallow burned hollow in a dry woodland footpath, for a hand-painted side-scrolling 2D cartoon game. References are the exact unburned and burned ground materials to blend into. Landscape 2:1 composition, isolated whole hollow with soft irregular leafy outer silhouette and ample transparent margin. A readable oval opening seen obliquely from the side, rough irregular earthen lip with scattered small stones, curved short interior earthen bank shaded charcoal brown, low flat ash floor at the bottom, a few small broken charred sticks and subdued red embers. The front edge is low and broken so a character standing inside remains clearly visible. The back lip is around upper third of the drawing, the flat walkable ash floor around three-quarters height, depth only about one small character's legs. Opaque painted earth interior, not a black void. The whole thing is an organic bowl depression in a path, absolutely not a floating island, platform or cutaway block. No rectangle, no vertical cube sides, no long roots, no dramatic bevel, no tall trees, no flames, no characters, no text. Restrained warm earthy colors, inked organic edges, simple painted shapes consistent with a 2D forest background. Ground inside and surrounding fringe should blend to both supplied dirt colors. Not 3D rendered.
